title: Replay of a Stored Word
statement: Let $B,F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose a Boolean mode `findMode`, an input word $x$, a base loop-host configuration, an input-head position $p$, Boolean tape functions for the flag and counter, an integer counter-head position $h$, and a Boolean word $w$. Starting from controller phase $13$, with payload tape storing $w$, payload head at $0$, and empty output, after exactly $|w|+1$ steps the loop host is halted and its output is exactly $w$.
replaced:
Let $w$ be a captured payload word and consider the loop host in its replay phase on a
frame with empty output whose payload track is the buffer tape of $w$ with head at zero.
After exactly $|w| + 1$ steps the host has halted and its output is exactly $w$.
